name: modrixcommerce/relay
description: Technology storefront with a white search header, blue category navigation, responsive product shelves, detailed catalog filters, gallery-led product pages and the native live section customizer.
author: Modrix team

changelog.notes: Product page: Add to cart and Buy now share the same height and corner radius as the quantity box.
Adds the actual storefront preview thumbnail and final customization/module documentation. Desktop, 390px and 320px shopping flows and live editor verified.

Uses Admin → Navigation menus (top, departments, mobile, footer) once saved; header and footer get a Menus setting. Reviews and other product modules now follow the description. Phones hide the category strip, since the bottom bar has Categories.
Reference-inspired Relay Electronics storefront, designed in MagicPath with original product imagery, native sticky headers, mobile shopping navigation, module hooks and full live customization.
